cases.sentence: Ерубаал, он же Гидеон, и все его люди встали рано утром и расположились лагерем у источника ___.
cases.translation: Then Jerubbaal, who is Gideon, and all the people who were with him, rose up early and encamped beside the spring of Harod.
cases.explain: The preposition у (near/by) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Господь сказал Гедеону, «Воинов с тобой слишком много, я не стану отдавать Мадианитян в их ___».
cases.translation: Yahweh said to Gideon, 'The people who are with you are too many for me to give the Midianites into their hand.'
cases.explain: Possession after руки (hand) requires the genitive case to indicate ownership.

cases.sentence: Чтобы Израиль не мог гордиться предо мной, будто его спасла его собственная ___, объяви воинам.
cases.translation: Now therefore proclaim in the ears of the people, lest Israel brag against me, saying, 'My own hand has saved me.'
cases.explain: Сила is the subject of the phrase standing in the nominative case.

cases.sentence: Двадцать две тысячи человек ушло, а десять тысяч осталось близ ___.
cases.translation: So twenty-two thousand of the people returned, and ten thousand remained near the mountain.
cases.explain: Numerical expressions with complex numerals take the genitive form of the noun.

cases.sentence: О ком я скажу тебе, этот пойдет с тобой, тот пойдет, а о ком скажу, этот с тобой не пойдет в ___.
cases.translation: It shall be, that those whom I tell you, 'This shall go with you,' shall go with you.
cases.explain: The preposition в (into) with motion governs the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Триста воинов лакали воду языком, поднося воду к корту ___.
cases.translation: The number of those who lapped, putting their hand to their mouth, was three hundred men.
cases.explain: The preposition к (to/toward) requires the dative, but here the accusative is used in the movement of water.

cases.sentence: Гидеон отпустил всех остальных израилетян по шатрам, но оставил триста воинов, которым достались запасы пищи и боевые рога ушедших в ___.
cases.translation: So the people took food in their hand, and their trumpets; and he sent all the rest of the men of Israel to their own tents.
cases.explain: The preposition в (in) with location requires the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Держа в левой руке факелы, а в правой рога, которые они трубили, они закричали «Меч за Господа и за ___».
cases.translation: Holding the torches in their left hands and the trumpets in their right hands, they shouted, 'The sword of Yahweh and of Gideon!'
cases.explain: The preposition за (for) with a person's name takes the accusative, but genitive is used here for possession.

reading.ru: Lагерь Мадианитян находился к северу от них, в долине рядом с холмом Море.
reading.question: Where was the Midianite camp located in relation to Gideon's camp?
options: To the north of them in the valley by the hill of Moreh
To the south in the mountains
To the east near the river
To the west in a fortified city
reading.correct: To the north of them in the valley by the hill of Moreh
reading.explain: The text clearly states the Midianite camp was on the north side in the valley by the hill of Moreh.

reading.ru: Чтобы Израиль не мог гордиться предо мной, будто его спасла его собственная сила, объяви воинам.
reading.question: Why did God say there were too many soldiers with Gideon?
options: So that Israel would not boast that their own hand saved them
Because the soldiers were afraid to fight
To punish Israel for their disobedience
reading.correct: So that Israel would not boast that their own hand saved them
reading.explain: God explicitly states that with too many soldiers, Israel would brag that their own hand had saved them.

reading.ru: Двадцать две тысячи человек ушло, а десять тысяч осталось.
reading.question: How many soldiers remained after the fearful left?
reading.explain: The text states that twenty-two thousand left and ten thousand remained.

reading.ru: Мне снился, — говорил он, — круглый чменный хлеб, который катился в Мадианский лагерь.
reading.question: What did the Midianite soldier dream about?
options: A round loaf of barley bread rolling into the Midian camp
A sword falling from the sky
reading.correct: A round loaf of barley bread rolling into the Midian camp
reading.explain: The soldier describes his dream of a round cake of barley bread tumbling into the camp of Midian.

reading.ru: Его друг ответил, «Это не что иное, как меч израилетянина Гидеона, сына Иааша».
reading.question: How did the Midianite interpret the dream?
options: As the sword of Gideon the son of Joash, a man of Israel
As a sign of their victory
As a blessing from their gods
reading.correct: As the sword of Gideon the son of Joash, a man of Israel
reading.explain: The fellow interpreted the dream as nothing other than the sword of Gideon son of Joash.

reading.ru: Разделив триста воинов на три отряда, он дал всем им в руки рога и пустые сосуды с факелами внутри.
reading.question: What weapons did Gideon give to his three hundred men?
options: Trumpets, empty pitchers with torches inside
reading.correct: Trumpets, empty pitchers with torches inside
reading.explain: The text states Gideon divided the men into three companies and gave them all trumpets and empty pitchers with torches within.
